purpose: Physically validate the real external-process stdin transport into app/task-invocation.js and through the real agent-loop visual fallback path without adding a Computer Use test hook.

p9b.task: Open the encoding selector for the current Pulsar document
p9b.externalTransport: stdin JSON to app/task-invocation.js in a real child process
p9b.resource: one explicit temporary Pulsar current-document file
p9b.fixturePreload: fixture-only preload wraps the real agent-loop runTask export, adds only the frozen semantic planner and physical dependencies, and captures bounded result metadata in an ephemeral temp file
assertions: real child process executes app/task-invocation.js and exits successfully
task bytes and one taskResourceContext are preserved across stdin/process boundary
no visualFallbackContracts visualFallbackCallerContext or documentPath shortcut crosses the invocation envelope
taskResourceContext derives exactly one pulsar-document caller context and one bounded P7D contract
semantic OPEN reaches structured NO_SEMANTIC_TARGET before visual provider selection
exact current-document window-title surface guard verifies before provider selection
local macOS Vision provider is selected exactly once
Computer Control CLICK_POSTED remains delivery only
independent post-action exact UTF-16 LE observation yields VERIFIED_SUCCESS
temporary document hash remains unchanged and encoding selection is not confirmed
child capture is ephemeral and no screenshot OCR payload or coordinates are logged
selector pointer Pulsar runtime and temp state are cleaned up

invariants: caller/resource provenance is explicit and is not inferred from UI state
planner contains no coordinates provider identity caller context resource identity scope surface identity or fabricated postcondition
provider selection remains Computer Use-owned and lazy after an eligible semantic gap and verified surface guard
Computer Control remains delivery mechanics only
no mandatory network account or cloud dependency

promotionOnPass.p9: external stdin task-invocation path validated for the single bounded Pulsar UTF-8 real-use case
promotionOnPass.next: Update evidence orchestration and handoff; then decide the next integration boundary without extending the claim to the default interactive CLI or generic Pulsar behavior.

nonClaims: P9B does not validate the default interactive CLI
P9B does not authorize generic Pulsar status-bar clicking or arbitrary targets
P9B does not authorize UI-derived resource provenance
P9B does not validate generic external protocols beyond the versioned stdin task-invocation envelope
P9B does not authorize generic browser or application visual fallback
